failure_class: production canonical ledger contains an immutable historical migration row absent from a successor manifest
trigger: official PostgreSQL migration runner manifest validation, apply, and verify
scope: only exact rows declared by canonicalLedgerCompatibility; active migration inventory and unknown-row rejection remain unchanged
red_proof: an undeclared extra row, checksum drift, dependency drift, missing dependency, duplicate declaration, or active-ID shadow is rejected
green_proof: the exact cm1-037-affiliate-profile-coverage row is accepted when present, while empty databases execute only active migrations
repair: declare the historical row with exact id, checksum, dependencies, source checksum, and reason in both base and successor manifests; never mutate the ledger
